head: claude/velotrade-api-probe-v4
title: ops: velotrade-api-probe v4 — print account type fields (positionBased) [HELD, Tier 2]
body:
## Summary

Lane VELOTRADE-WIRE, API-order-path question (manager, 2026-10-05 12:54Z). DXtrade REST brackets (IF-THEN order groups) are only valid on a **position-based** account. v3 printed `positionBased` as a key name but not its value (memo `docs/research/velotrade-api-probe-2026-10-05.md` § 4).

This change makes the probe also print a fixed allowlist of non-identifying account **type** fields, by value, once per account: `positionBased`, `accountType`, `type`, `status`, `accountStatus`, `marginMode`, `marginCalculationType`, `hedging`, `currency`, `baseCurrency`.
- Only scalars of 32 characters or fewer are printed.
- Account codes, names and ids are never printed, and are still redacted everywhere.

The probe stays **read-only**. The HTTP method allowlist is unchanged (GET, `POST /login`, `POST /logout`), and `/orders` is still refused in code.

**HELD (Tier 2, `landing: hold`)**: the manager reviews and merges, then dispatches `velotrade-api-probe` once. The result feeds the API-vs-browser executor design memo (separate PR).

## Architecture impact

- [x] **Not applicable** — this adds output lines to an existing read-only probe.

## Test plan

- [x] `python -m py_compile` and `ruff check` pass on `scripts/prop/velotrade_api_probe.py`.
- [x] `check_pr_landing`: `declared_needs_approval`. `manager-scope`: `no_manager_commits`.
- [ ] CI green
- [ ] After merge: one dispatch prints `account#1 type: {...positionBased...}`.
